description: This Java class 'LoanRefundValidator' contains validation methods for processing loan refund transactions within the Fineract project, including checks for overpayment, transaction dates, refund eligibility, and transaction amount thresholds.

classes.name: LoanRefundValidator
classes.description: A final class providing validation methods for loan refund transactions, ensuring business rules are followed before processing refunds.

methods.name: validateTransferRefund
methods.description: Validates that the refund transfer is permissible based on overpayment status and last repayment date.

methods.name: validateTransactionDateAfterDisbursement
methods.description: Ensures the transaction date is not before the loan disbursement date.

methods.name: validateCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Checks that the refund amount is greater than zero and does not exceed the total overpaid amount.

methods.name: validateRefundEligibility
methods.description: Verifies that the loan is active and has payments made before allowing a refund.

methods.name: validateRefundTransactionType
methods.description: Ensures the transaction type is a refund for an active loan.

methods.name: validateTransactionDateNotInFuture
methods.description: Checks that the transaction date is not set in the future.

methods.name: validateTransactionAmountThreshold
methods.description: Validates that the transaction amount does not exceed the threshold for multi-disburse loans.
